name: plan_cdgx_bd_lyon
label: The plan, CDG Express through the old RER B and D tunnel to Châtelet and Gare de Lyon
about: CDG Express as planned for 28 March 2027 (a train every 15 minutes, 20 minutes without a stop), brought onto the tracks of RER B at Gare du Nord as line K would be, then through the tunnel RER B and D share today to Châtelet-Les Halles and along RER D to Gare de Lyon, in the minutes of RER D (ASSUMPTION). Needs RER D out of that tunnel (annex D): the old tunnel then carries RER B, line K and CDG Express.
